places.ai_summary: A charming area with cobblestone streets, historic buildings, and vibrant shops and cafes.

opening_hours.notes: Shops and cafes have varying hours.

places.place_tip: Explore the hidden alleys for unique finds.

places.ai_summary: The oldest public art collection in Switzerland, featuring works from the Middle Ages to contemporary art.

opening_hours.notes: Free admission on Tuesdays and Wednesdays after 5 PM.

places.place_tip: Check out the museum shop for unique art books.

places.ai_summary: The city hall of Basel, known for its stunning red facade and lively market square.

places.name: Rhine Promenade & Swimming

places.ai_summary: A museum showcasing the history of paper-making, located in a former paper mill.

opening_hours.notes: Closed on Mondays and public holidays.
